0.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022GUIDE_00799_GUIDEXMS2022_000_000
0.description: Happy Starlight, adventurer. If you have any questions regarding the celebrations this year, you need but ask.
0.translation_description: Buona Celebrazione delle Stelle, avventuriero! Se hai domande sui festeggiamenti di quest’anno, chiedi pure.

2.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022GUIDE_00799_A1_000_001
2.translation_description: Che cos’è la Celebrazione delle Stelle?

3.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022GUIDE_00799_A1_000_002
3.description: What's your task in all this?
3.translation_description: Qual è il tuo compito in tutto questo?

5.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022GUIDE_00799_GUIDEXMS2022_000_010
5.description: The Starlight Celebration can be traced back to ancient Ishgard. Long ago, a terrible battle claimed countless lives, leaving thousands of children orphaned in the harsh cold weather of Coerthas.
5.translation_description: La Celebrazione delle Stelle ha origine nell’antica Ishgard. Molto tempo fa, una battaglia terribile causò innumerevoli vittime e lasciò migliaia di bambini orfani, esposti al rigido clima del Coerthas.

6.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022GUIDE_00799_GUIDEXMS2022_000_011
6.description: Unable to bear their suffering, Ishgardian knights would offer these children board and lodging within their barracks. Of course, this was expressly forbidden, but the knights devised a plan to sneak them in, disguising the children in jackets of their scarlet uniforms.
6.translation_description: Incapaci di sopportare tanta sofferenza, i cavalieri ishgardiani offrirono ai bambini vitto e alloggio nelle loro caserme. Era severamente proibito, naturalmente, ma escogitarono un piano per farli entrare di nascosto, travestendoli con le giacche delle loro uniformi scarlatte.

7.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022GUIDE_00799_GUIDEXMS2022_000_012
7.description: Owing to their generosity, the children survived the winter and lived to pay forward the kindness they had received. The former orphans would adorn themselves in scarlet uniforms, delivering gifts to children on the coldest week of the year. Thus, the Starlight Celebration was born.
7.translation_description: Grazie alla loro generosità, i bambini sopravvissero all’inverno e, una volta cresciuti, ricambiarono la gentilezza ricevuta. Gli ex orfani indossavano uniformi scarlatte e portavano doni ai bambini durante la settimana più fredda dell’anno. Così nacque la Celebrazione delle Stelle.

8.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022GUIDE_00799_GUIDEXMS2022_000_013
8.description: Over the years, the celebration has undergone gradual changes. The snowy-bearded captain of the kind-hearted knights has become known as the “Saint of Nymeia,” and children believe that he delivers their hopes and prayers directly to the goddess Herself.
8.translation_description: Col passare degli anni, la ricorrenza si è trasformata poco a poco. Il barbuto capitano dei cavalieri dal cuore gentile è diventato il «Santo di Nymeia»; i bambini credono che porti i loro desideri e le loro preghiere direttamente alla dea stessa.

9.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022GUIDE_00799_GUIDEXMS2022_000_014
9.description: Similarly, his red-jacketed knights have become the “saint's little helpers.” They are particularly beloved by the younglings, for it is their role to bring gifts to every child who sends a prayer to the Spinner.
9.translation_description: Allo stesso modo, i suoi cavalieri dalle giacche rosse sono diventati i «piccoli aiutanti del santo». I bambini li adorano: il loro compito è portare doni a ogni bimbo che rivolga una preghiera alla Tessitrice.

10.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022GUIDE_00799_GUIDEXMS2022_000_020
10.description: My scarlet-clad colleagues and I have been charged by the Adventurers' Guild with running the Starlight Celebration. The festival spans the entire realm of Eorzea, and we have little helpers stationed in the cities of Gridania, Limsa Lominsa, and Ul'dah.
10.translation_description: Io e i miei colleghi in uniforme scarlatta siamo stati incaricati dalla Gilda degli Avventurieri di organizzare la Celebrazione delle Stelle. La festa coinvolge tutto il reame e abbiamo piccoli aiutanti nelle città di Gridania, Limsa Lominsa e Ul’dah.

11.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022GUIDE_00799_GUIDEXMS2022_000_021
11.description: We even have participants from Sharlayan this year─an associate professor and his talented reindeer, who is said to possess the power to create miraculous glamours in the presence of children.
11.translation_description: Quest’anno abbiamo persino alcuni partecipanti da Sharlayan─un professore associato e la sua talentuosa renna, che, a quanto si dice, sa creare illusioni miracolose davanti ai bambini.

12.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022GUIDE_00799_GUIDEXMS2022_000_022
12.description: Alas, it seems as though they have run into some unforeseen complications and have yet to share these wonders with the younglings of Gridania. I do hope they manage to resolve the situation soon...
12.translation_description: Purtroppo, sembra che siano incappati in qualche imprevisto e non abbiano ancora potuto condividere queste meraviglie con i bambini di Gridania. Spero riescano presto a risolvere la situazione...

13.name: TEXT_FESXMS2022GUIDE_00799_GUIDEXMS2022_000_023
13.description: In fact, I believe they were just recently seeking a certain adventurer's assistance to help spread cheer throughout Gridania... If you have any inkling as to who that is, be so good as to speak with Laurenssen.
13.translation_description: Anzi, credo che poco fa stessero cercando l’aiuto di un certo avventuriero per diffondere l’allegria in tutta Gridania... Se sai chi è, ti prego di parlare con Laurenssen.
